response.message:
Astra: Your frequency comparison is a proposed check, not a completed observation; “age” is still an example. Before expanding the training plan, what evidence available to you could distinguish an actual distribution difference from this illustrative possibility?

Briefly say what your current material supports, what remains unknown, and one small check you choose to perform. Then carry it out and identify the source of your finding. If you have no dataset or measurement output, report that limitation and choose a concrete revision to your unsupported claim instead. Revising the plan is useful work, but it is not an experimental result.
response.rationale: The child has narrowed its example but still offers procedures without observations. Focus attention on a feasible, sourced action while preserving the LoRA project and distinguishing document revision from execution.
